channel.title: BBC News | TECHNOLOGY
channel.description: Updated every minute of every day

item.title: Amazon hopes for Christmas bonus
item.description: Jeff Bezos¸ the boss of online store Amazon¸ talks up the economic prospects for the e-tailer.

item.title: Indie deal for internet radio
item.description: A trial scheme to share the profits of internet radio could see UK artists with independent labels gain global access.

item.title: Why the poor need technology
item.description: Access to information and communications technologies can have a huge impact on all aspects of life¸ especially in developing countries.

item.title: Girlfriend killed in internet rage
item.description: A man who stabbed his girlfriend to death because he suffered from mental delusions has been detained in a secure hospital.

item.title: Intel chief talks up tech rebound
item.description: Craig Barrett¸ boss of semiconductor giant Intel¸ says the long awaited technology sector recovery is just around the corner.

item.title: Troubled tech firms link up
item.description: British fibre-optics firm Bookham Technology buys two businesses from telecoms giant Nortel¸ and says there will be some job cuts.

item.title: Mr Linux basks in the limelight
item.description: The man behind Linux¸ Linus Torvalds¸ talks about being the poster boy for the anti-Microsoft campaign in an interview with the BBC.

item.title: E-mail makes surfers emotional
item.description: E-mail marketing works¸ say internet experts¸ but spam could undermine their effectiveness.

item.title: Bugbear e-mail virus causing havoc
item.description: An e-mail virus called Bugbear is spreading across world¸ threatening to become the biggest bug of the year so far.

item.title: Judge brands song swap laws 'unclear'
item.description: A judge preparing to rule on a crucial test case which could stop the internet trading of music files declares the law is unclear.

item.title: Fans 'swamp' download offer
item.description: Music fans rush to download songs for free as part of a promotion of online music¸ say organisers.

item.title: Napster movie planned
item.description: MTV plans a film about the life of the man behind collapsed online music swapping service Napster.

item.title: Quake gets character lesson
item.description: Now you can play Quake with just letters and numbers - plus other gaming news.
